description: Enhance the second batch of 4 widgets (Testimonials Slider, FAQ Search, CTA Form, Trust Strip) with modern animations, improved interactivity, and visual polish.
steps: Read and enhance widgets/class-testimonials-slider.php: Add improved 3D depth effect with parallax on mouse move (transform-style preserve-3d), add smooth card transition with perspective rotation, add subtle floating animation on non-active cards, add glassmorphism enhancement on active card, add IntersectionObserver entrance animation, add prefers-reduced-motion support.

Read and enhance widgets/class-faq-search.php: Add smooth accordion height animation using max-height or grid-template-rows technique for expanding/collapsing, add character count or answer length indicator that animates on expand, add subtle highlight/flash animation when a search match is found, add staggered entrance animation for FAQ items, add input focus glow effect on search field, add prefers-reduced-motion support.

Read and enhance widgets/class-cta-form.php: Add field focus glow effects with animated border gradient, add animated submit button states (idle shimmer, loading spinner, success checkmark), add subtle glass-morphism depth enhancement with layered backgrounds, add floating label animation on focus, add form card entrance animation via IntersectionObserver, add prefers-reduced-motion support.

Read and enhance widgets/class-trust-strip.php: Add infinite scroll/marquee animation for logos strip (CSS animation with translateX), add logo hover tooltip with subtle scale-up, add entrance animation for showcase mode, add device mockup subtle breathing animation, add prefers-reduced-motion support.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 widget files pass php -l syntax check without errors
Each widget has IntersectionObserver-based scroll entrance animations in its JS section
FAQ widget has smooth height transition animation for accordion panels
CTA Form has animated button states (loading/success)
Trust Strip has infinite marquee/scroll animation for logos
All CSS animations use transform and opacity for performance
verification: Verify each file contains 'IntersectionObserver' in its JS section
Verify each file contains 'prefers-reduced-motion' in its CSS section
